code: PLIST_API int plist_from_openstep(const char *plist_ostep, uint32_t length, plist_t * plist)
note: Fuzzer-controlled OpenStep plist bytes enter the parser here.
A parsed node is allocated and becomes the object later freed by the caller.

On parse failure after a partially built tree was already stored in *plist, the code must not free that tree again later; the safety obligation is that ownership should be transferred or cleared before this cleanup path.
The parse result controls whether the cleanup path runs and whether *plist still points to freed memory.
The fuzz target passes the input into the parser and then retains the returned pointer for destruction.
The fuzzer frees the returned tree, triggering a heap-use-after-free when root_node still aliases memory already released in the parser.
